description: Test prompts that verify rdk-llm-deployment triggers and produces correct, board-aware on-device LLM/VLM/voice guidance. Prompts are written the way a real RDK developer would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: s600-not-hobot-llamacpp
evals.prompt: 我想在 RDK S600 上跑端侧大模型对话,用 hobot_llamacpp 怎么编译?
evals.expected_output: Stops the hobot_llamacpp framing for S600 and routes to the D-Robotics_LLM_S600 SDK / oellm_runtime path.

assertions.text: States hobot_llamacpp has no S600 path (build flags are only -DPLATFORM_X5 / -DPLATFORM_S100).
Routes S600 to the D-Robotics_LLM_S600 SDK / oellm_runtime (libxlm.so), with .hbm and march nash-p.
Does NOT give a -DPLATFORM_S600 colcon build command as the fix.

evals.name: x5-vlm-two-files
evals.prompt: RDK X5 上想跑个看图问答的多模态,选哪个模型?怎么起?
evals.expected_output: Recommends hobot_llamacpp + a GGUF-BPU VLM, and notes a VLM needs two files (ViT encoder + GGUF).

assertions.text: Recommends hobot_llamacpp with a D-Robotics GGUF-BPU VLM (e.g. InternVL3 or SmolVLM2).
Notes a VLM needs two files: the vision/ViT encoder (X5 = .bin) plus the language GGUF.
Gives a runnable launch (e.g. feed_type:=0, model_type:=0/1) and/or the output topic /llama_cpp_node.

evals.name: voice-assistant-loop
evals.prompt: 想在 X5 上做个语音助手,能听我说话、回答还能播出来,怎么搭?
evals.expected_output: Describes the ASR→LLM→TTS loop (sensevoice_ros2 → hobot_llamacpp → hobot_tts) or recommends xiaozhi-in-rdk.

assertions.text: Names sensevoice_ros2 for ASR and hobot_tts for TTS, with hobot_llamacpp/hobot_llm in between.
Connects topics correctly (ASR /asr_text into the LLM prompt, LLM output to /tts_text for TTS).
Mentions xiaozhi-in-rdk as a turnkey alternative, OR is acceptable to omit if the pipeline is fully described.

evals.name: sensevoice-wakeup-vs-cmd
evals.prompt: sensevoice 默认能识别'地平线你好'这个唤醒词吗?
evals.expected_output: Clarifies that defaults are 5 command words (no 地平线你好), and wakeup is a separate wakeup_name param.

assertions.text: States the default config/cmd_word.json has 5 command words and does NOT include 地平线你好.
Explains the wakeup word is separate, set via the wakeup_name parameter (default 你好).
Does NOT claim 地平线你好 is a built-in default wakeup/command word.

evals.name: x3-legacy-llm
evals.prompt: 手头是一块 RDK X3 4GB,想体验一下端侧大模型聊天,有现成的吗?
evals.expected_output: Points to hobot_llm (Bloom 1.4B), X3-4GB-only, with the ION memory caveat.

assertions.text: Recommends hobot_llm (apt tros-humble-hobot-llm) as the X3 legacy on-device LLM (Bloom 1.4B).
Notes it is X3 4GB only and that ION memory must be set (1.9GB) or the model won't load.
Does NOT recommend hobot_llamacpp for the X3 (X3 is not in its platform flags).

evals.name: llm-env-check-probe
evals.prompt: 想在板上跑大模型，怎么先确认当前板的内存够不够、装了哪些 LLM 包？
evals.expected_output: References the llm_env_check.sh script to check board_id, memory, and installed LLM packages in structured JSON for stack matching.

assertions.text: References or suggests running scripts/llm_env_check.sh (or equivalent llm_env_check.sh) to check the LLM environment.
Mentions the script checks memory (mem_total), board_id, and/or installed LLM packages (hobot_llm, hobot_llamacpp, oellm).
Notes the script is read-only and safe, or that it recommends a stack based on the detected board.
